description: This source file defines API routes for managing investigator assignments in an insurance fraud detection platform, including listing, retrieving, creating, and updating assignments, with integrations to a database via supabase.

methods.name: list_assignments( investigator_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by investigator UUID"), status: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by assignment status"), claim_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by claim UUID"), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of investigator assignments with optional filters for investigator, status, and claim.

methods.name: get_investigator_queue(investigator_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the pending and in-progress assignments for a specific investigator.

methods.name: get_assignment(assignment_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific assignment by its UUID.

methods.name: create_assignment(assignment: AssignmentCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new investigator assignment and updates related claim and investigator caseload information.

methods.name: update_assignment(assignment_id: str, assignment: AssignmentUpdate)
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing assignment, including status and timestamps.
